title.narrative: Promote animal disease control and prevention in the targeted areas.

description.narrative: The overall Objective of this project is to contribute to the use of a holistic value chain approach in the targeted geographical areas, to leverage an increase in the overall performance of veterinary/animals health services delivery (in terms of production volume, quality, value addition, increased employment and environmental sustainability) of the Ugandan meat value-chain.Its outcome or specific objective is to promote animal disease control and prevention in Central and South western regions of Uganda.
